summary: Secrets management without a secrets server: sops and age encrypt env files you commit, a wrapper decrypts them into a process and never to disk, environments have different recipients so a laptop key cannot read production, CI holds one key, rotation removes a leaver, and a push command feeds one platform.

stack.why: rule zero: do not invent a scheme

stack.choice: A small shell or Node script
stack.why: decrypt into a child process environment only

prerequisites.name: A terminal and a code editor
prerequisites.why: Every step below is a command you type or a file you edit.
prerequisites.get: VS Code (code.visualstudio.com), Cursor or Zed. Open a folder for the project and use the editor's built-in terminal.
prerequisites.verify: You can open a folder and run a command in its terminal

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.why: History for your code, and the way most hosts deploy.
prerequisites.get: Install from git-scm.com or with your package manager, then run git init in the project folder once it exists.

prerequisites.name: sops and age
prerequisites.get: brew install sops age, or the releases pages. age-keygen -o key.txt creates a key pair.

prerequisites.name: One age key per person and one for CI, and where the private keys live
prerequisites.why: Recipients define who can decrypt each environment.
prerequisites.get: Each person runs age-keygen; the private key goes in their password manager, the public key into .sops.yaml.

prerequisites.name: The platform you deploy to (optional)
prerequisites.why: Phase 5 pushes secrets into one platform via its CLI.
prerequisites.get: Vercel, Railway or Fly CLI logged in.

prerequisites.name: A CI with repository secrets
prerequisites.why: CI holds only the age private key.
prerequisites.get: GitHub Actions: Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions.

env.name: SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE
env.where: Where sops finds your private key locally.

env.name: SOPS_AGE_KEY
env.where: The CI private key, set only in the CI secret store.

phases.title: Keys and one file
phases.goal: An encrypted dev.env committed; plaintext never can be.

steps.do: Generate keys and write .sops.yaml mapping secrets/*.env to recipients
A pre-commit hook refusing any unencrypted *.env

check: The encrypted file is committed and git log shows no plaintext

phases.title: Runtime
phases.goal: secrets run --env dev -- npm start, nothing decrypted to disk.

steps.do: The run wrapper using sops exec-env
Verify no decrypted file exists afterward

check: The app starts with its secrets

phases.title: Environments and CI
phases.goal: Prod excludes laptops; CI decrypts with its own key.

steps.do: staging.env and prod.env with different recipient lists
A GitHub Actions job decrypting with SOPS_AGE_KEY from repository secrets

check: A dev key cannot decrypt prod
CI runs with its secrets and no plaintext in the workflow

phases.title: Rotation and audit
phases.goal: Remove a leaver; see who changed what.

steps.do: A rotate command re-encrypting every file for the current recipients
A log command over git history of the secrets folder

check: A removed recipient cannot decrypt the new files

phases.title: Sync where needed
phases.goal: One platform fed from the encrypted file.

steps.do: A push command writing selected keys via the platform CLI
README: where private keys live, what a leak means, the rotate procedure

check: A change in the encrypted file reaches the platform with one command

phases.title: Team hygiene

steps.do: An onboarding script adding a recipient and rotating
A quarterly rotation reminder for the CI key

check: A new person is onboarded in five minutes
The CI key rotation is documented and tested

product.outcome: Secrets with access control and history, no server to run, and a platform sync you control.

operations.backup: The repo; private keys in password managers.
operations.incident: A leaked private key: remove the recipient, rotate, and rotate every secret it could read.

notIncluded: Dynamic secrets, sync to every platform, per-person access in a UI.
after: Infisical self-hosted when the team outgrows files
